dataList.dlg: 最后刺穿敌人咽喉的可是吾之长枪！那一个理应算吾的吧？这样汝便是两个，小辛克莱。公平即是公平。 这算什么逻辑？那一个是我们两个一起捅穿的——所以一人两个半。说真的，你怎么能一本正经地说出这种话？ 'Twas my spear that skewered the foe's throat last! Surely that kill is mine to claim? That leaves thee with two, young Sinclair. Fair's fair. What kind of logic is that? We both ran that one through—so that's two and a half each. Seriously, how do you say that with a straight face?

<color=#ffef23>小辛克莱！！快来橱柜这边……！劳驾，把麦片拿下来……！是谁把它放得这么高的？！</color>
……我放的。当时我还够得着，现在够不着了。
<color=#ffef23>那、那个嘛……</color>
我说，你当初要是肯好好看看保险的细则，我也不至于变成这样……
 <color=#ffef23>Young Sinclair!! Come thee to the cupboard...! Prithee, fetch down the cereal...! Who saw fit to place it at such a lofty height?!</color>
... I did. When I used to be able to reach it. Now I can't.
<color=#ffef23>W-well, that's...</color>
You know, if you'd actually bothered to read the fine print on the insurance, I wouldn't have been stuck like this...

“糖醋肉（Tangsuyuk）”。“牛肉汤（Yukgaejang）”！“火腿黄油法棍（Jambon-beurre）”。Re……“勒布罗申芝士焗土豆（Reblochon on potato gratin）”！呃……Tang……“汤包（Tangbao）”……？O……“蛋包饭（Omurice）”！汝意下如何？呵。“斯莫雷布洛（Smørrebrød）”。诶诶诶？！“Ble”？“Bro”？那是何种食物？！是一种开放式三明治。好了，看来今天的午饭你请。*呜呃* 好吧。吾这就去买份蛋包饭……打包。 "Tangsuyuk". "Yukgaejang"! "Jambon-beurre". Re... "Reblochon on potato gratin"! Ugh... Tang... "Tangbao"...? O... "Omurice"! What sayest thou to that? Heh. "Smørrebrød". Ehhhh?! "Ble"? "Bro"? What manner of food is that?! It's an open-faced sandwich. All right, then. Guess you're buying lunch today. *groan* Very well. I shall fetch some omurice... to go.

<color=#ffef23>呜嗯……！*呼* *呼* 每天晚上……都是同一个噩梦——那些恶徒将小辛克莱撕得四分五裂，一遍又一遍……</color>
……？你叫我？
<color=#ffef23>啊，不、不！没什么，什么事都没有！</color>
 <color=#ffef23>Nnngh...! *huff* *huff* Every evening... 'tis the same nightmare—those wretches tearing young Sinclair limb from limb, again and again...</color>
...? Did you call me?
<color=#ffef23>Ah, n-nay! 'Tis nothing, nothing at all!</color>

……堂吉诃德，你可别告诉我你忘了马上要续保的事。
<color=#ffef23>嗯？！不、不，当然没忘……！</color>
……还有，把附加项目也过一遍。我发誓，你要是再忘了给克隆身体加上生长针剂的保障，我就……*唉*
<color=#ffef23>诚然，那是吾之过错……吾认错还认得不够多吗……？</color>
 ... Don Quixote, please tell me you haven't forgotten the upcoming insurance renewal.
<color=#ffef23>Hm?! N-nay, of course not...!</color>
... And go over the add-ons. I swear, if you forget to get the clone body's growth shots covered again, I'm gonna... *sigh*
<color=#ffef23>'Twas my fault, forsooth... Have I not admitted my guilt often enough...?</color>

啧……我说，你越来越让人受不了了。又没人说你错了什么。 诚然，吾等应给他一些空间，小辛克莱……他尚未恢复…… 不，够了。我们只是说这一单活儿可以一起干，因为你这种想法的收尾人跟我们事务所不合，就这么简单。结果你倒好，突然摆出一副苦大仇深的混账样！你能不能……算了。听着，你这小——别再板着张脸了行不行？ Ugh... You know, you're getting insufferable. Nobody said you were wrong or anything. Verily, we ought to give him some space, young Sinclair... He hath yet to recover... No, enough is enough. All we said was we'll work together on this one job 'cause Fixers who think like you aren't a good fit for our Office, simple as that. And you had to be a miserable ass about it out of the blue! Could you please... never mind. Look, you little—stop frowning already, would you?

汝且看，楔子乃是与劈砍和碾压最为无缘的武器。看看吾这杆长枪针尖般锋利的枪头：汝看见了吗？！此乃效率无与伦比的武器！最为专一的一击、最为精细的专注，施展起来几乎无需多少力气。这便是与“楔子”相称的工作！ 因此！那些怀揣委托前来本事务所的人，期待的并非蛮力，不；而是迅捷与精准……建立在敏锐而精确的局势判断这一基石之上！嘿嘿，这便是吾等的事务所！ A wedge, thou seest, is a weapon most divorced from cleaving and crushing. Behold the pinpoint-keen tip of this spear mine: dost thou see?! 'Tis a weapon of unparalleled efficiency! A strike most singular and focus most fine requireth little strength to execute. Such is the work befitting a "Wedge!" Consequently! Those who seek our Office with a quest in their bosom expect no brute strength, nay; 'tis swiftness and precision... founded upon the bedrock of shrewd and precise situational assessment! Heh heh, that is what our Office is!

现在可不是能讲礼貌的情况。我这就把你捅个对穿。
<color=#ffef23>身为收尾人，人命关天之际，吾实在顾不上礼数周全！汝定能理解吧！</color>
 Not exactly the kind of situation where we can afford to be polite. I'll get to skewering you right away.
<color=#ffef23>As a Fixer, I can scarce afford proper etiquette when lives stand at stake! Surely thou canst understand!</color>

我们事务所对那些喜欢把自己打扮成“无私”的混账尤其没耐心。要是其中最自私的那个自己还没意识到这一点，那就更是加倍。
 Our Office has particularly low tolerance for dickheads who like to dress themselves up as "selfless." Doubly so when the most selfish of them don't seem to realize that himself.

……那个小混混还要赖在我们事务所多久？
<color=#ffef23>恳请汝耐心些！汝还记得奥提斯女士的保证吧？此番委托一完成，他便会离开。</color>
 ... How long is that punk going to leech on our Office?
<color=#ffef23>Prithee, practice patience! Thou recallest Lady Outis's reassurance, dost thou not? He shall depart anon following this contract's completion.</color>

喂，现在别瞪我们。我们只是戳你一下确认确认。
<color=#ffef23>嘿嘿，吾听闻汝本该是个“好人”——吾对汝别无所求，只盼汝慷慨到极致！</color>
 Hey, don't glare at us now. We just poked you to make sure.
<color=#ffef23>Heh heh, I had heard that thou wert supposed to be "nice"—I expect naught else but the maximum generosity from thee!</color>

……你是想跟我找茬吗？
 ... Are you trying to pick a fight with me?

我会把你们全都捅穿。
 I'll skewer you all.

dataList.dlg:
……是堂吉诃德让你来找我的吧？告诉她，我也没空闲聊！
 ... Don Quixote told you to talk to me, didn't she? Tell her I don't have time for chit-chat either!

刺穿！
 Skewer!

速战速决吧。
 Let's make this quick.

啧，一点用都没有……
 Tsk, no help at all...

反正你们这些家伙最后都会被串起来。
 You guys always end up on a skewer, anyway.

真是……蠢透了的一步……
 What an... idiotic move...

……分内之事罢了。
 ... All in a day's work.
……第一遍就听到了！拜托，这次一定得对啊…… ... Heard you the first time! C'mon, this has to be right...

<color=#ffef23>呼……又了结了一项委托！小辛克莱，稍事歇息如何？</color>
虽然还有些头疼的事要处理……嗯，到这份上也无所谓了，对吧？
 <color=#ffef23>Phew... That be one quest behind us! What sayest thou, young Sinclair, to a moment's respite?</color>
We still have some headaches to deal with, but... Eh, it's whatever at this point, right?

dataList.dlg:
虽然他们给我们添了点麻烦，但——
<color=#ffef23>——诚然，委托一经接下，便没有吾等完成不了的！</color>
是啊，这次委托也——
<color=#ffef23>——以最楔子的方式了结了！</color>
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！我靠，你能不能有一秒钟别打断我说话？！
 They gave us some trouble, but—
<color=#ffef23>—verily, once accepted, no contract is beyond us!</color>
Yeah, this contract was also—
<color=#ffef23>—settled in the Wedgiest fashion!</color>
ARRRGH!!!!! Holy shit, can you stop cutting me off for one damn second?!

该死的小混混……我就知道一出事他就会溜之大吉……
<color=#ffef23>唉……这结果早在意料之中，不是吗……？</color>
啧，别说话……！你流的血要超出保险肯赔的额度了……
 Damn punk... I knew he'd hightail it the moment shit hit the fan...
<color=#ffef23>Alas... 'twas an expected outcome, was it not...?</color>
Tsk, don't talk...! You're gonna lose more blood than insurance's willing to cover...
